_comment: Hand-curated install instructions per harness. The drift-check 'make verify-install-guide' diffs these against the canonical sources (docs/docs/guides/getting-started.mdx + ailang_bootstrap/README.md). When you update getting-started or ailang_bootstrap, update this file too — CI will fail otherwise.

what_you_get: AILANG binary auto-installed for your platform
Local stdio MCP tools: ailang_prompt, ailang_check, ailang_run, ailang_builtins
Slash commands: /ailang:prompt, /ailang:new, /ailang:run, /ailang:challenge
Teaching prompts loaded automatically
Plus the remote ailang-docs MCP at https://mcp.ailang.sunholo.com/mcp/ for live docs
post_install: Run `ailang prompt` to print current syntax rules
Run `ailang examples list --tags effects` to find working code samples
Call `onboarding_guide(role="agent")` from the remote MCP for the full agent workflow

commands: # Pick the right tarball for your platform from GitHub Releases:
what_you_get: AILANG binary at /usr/local/bin/ailang (or wherever you put it)
Embedded teaching prompts (offline-available via `ailang prompt --source embedded`)
All CLI commands: ailang run, ailang check, ailang verify, ailang repl, etc.
post_install: Add the remote MCP to your harness manually for live docs:
For Claude Desktop, use the mcp-remote bridge: `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.ailang.sunholo.com/mcp/`
Run `ailang prompt` to print current syntax rules
Run `ailang mcp status` to verify the remote MCP is reachable

build-from-source.display_name: Build from source (developers / latest dev branch)
what_you_get: AILANG binary at $GOPATH/bin/ailang (typically /Users/<you>/go/bin/ailang)
Latest dev-branch features (not yet released)
Full source for hacking on the language itself
post_install: Re-run `make install` after pulling new commits
Use `make quick-install` for fast iterations during development

remote_mcp.what_for: Live, version-locked AILANG documentation, stdlib, examples, benchmarks, and a public-feedback channel — typed MCP tools instead of scraping markdown.
